study.initial_observations: 3 mode-one training plus2 mode-one development, all5 charged
study.learner_seed: 958000+spec_index, identical for paired policies and noise conditions
study.global_freeze: all 216 policy episodes and 1080 declared budget slots frozen before generating 54 clean final references; unavailable checkpoints remain failed slots
study.final_release_tracking: data/final_release.json created exclusively before first final generation; scientific-source and deterministic-task identity survive new preparation timestamps; later outputs are reproductions
study.primary_metrics: budget9 noise1 mean across18 parameter tasks of the maximum true-term relative coefficient error; structure and forecast guardrails retained
study.predeclared_promotion: primary mean at least10% lower than fixed_rich and rich_then_variance, no worse than other retained controls, with predeclared structure and forecast guardrails; offline reporting only
study.offline_success: exact support AND worst true coefficient error<=10% AND three-trajectory mean forecast relativeL2<=5%
study.cost_savings: only at same predeclared80% offline-success target; unavailable if either policy never reaches it
study.uncertainty_metrics: support-set coverage and size, singleton-wrong diagnostic, positive/negative term Brier separately; frequencies are not calibrated probabilities
study.scope: fresh controlled synthetic coefficient-information study; old active results and KS5.4104% result unchanged

actions.amplitude_certificate: maximum on 4096-point periodic grid plus sum(k*hypot(a,b))*pi/4096
actions.candidate_pool: four fixed all-six-mode rich phase variants, twelve single-mode actions, sixteen random 2..6-mode mixtures
actions.initial_excitation: mode one only, five separately drawn phases; same physical excitation spectrum
actions.fixed_baseline: four predefined all-six-mode rich phase variants; no truth-dependent selection
actions.pool_seed_input: nonnegative integer seed; no family, coefficient or observation input

provider.kind: controlled synthetic initial-condition queries, not measured data
provider.task_index_rule: family=index%6, coefficient replicate=index//6; same family/action spaces for all policies
provider.noise_rule: 0.4*noise_level*standard_normal(111,64), caller supplies query seed; no trajectory-RMS oracle
provider.measurement_count: 111*64 distinct observations; shared history endpoint counted once
provider.linear_reference: exact Fourier evolution under hidden linear symbol; independent of discovery forecast
provider.nonlinear_reference: independent contour ETDRK4 Fourier Galerkin Burgers reference
provider.refinement: double spatial reference grid and halve timestep; same prescribed initial field
provider.observation_rule: direct reference-grid samples, never sparse-sensor interpolation
provider.formal_generation_guard: controller freezes protocol before formal tasks; provider does not enforce global lifecycle
provider.final_generation_guard: controller freezes all policy snapshots before final queries
provider.scope: six fixed one-dimensional periodic scalar equation families, varying coefficients; not arbitrary PDE discovery

weak_protocol.spatial_tests: nonnegative Fourier modes; real/imaginary rows, nonzero modes sqrt(2) weighted
weak_protocol.temporal_test: (1-z*z)^4 on [-1,1], zero outside; analytic first derivative
weak_protocol.products: 2N zero-padded real trigonometric interpolation; retain selected observed-grid Fourier modes
weak_protocol.quadrature: composite degree-nine Newton-Cotes on original samples, eight subintervals per panel
weak_protocol.selection: unchanged L1 path, normalized OLS debias and development forecast selection

sparse_protocol.trajectory_weighting: rows multiplied by sqrt(total_rows/(trajectory_count*own_rows)) before global RMS
sparse_protocol.normalization: one pooled training feature RMS per column and one pooled training target RMS
sparse_protocol.ridge_pilot: solve(X.T@X/n + alpha*I, X.T@y/n) in normalized coordinates
sparse_protocol.irl1_initialization: independent same ridge pilot for each alpha; no warm starts across alpha
sparse_protocol.irl1_update: same inverse-absolute-coefficient weights after each solve
sparse_protocol.debias: OLS on original normalized candidate columns; rcond=1e-10
sparse_protocol.exact_derivatives: analytic features and analytic u_t supplied independently, never reconstructed from a fitted PDE
sparse_protocol.pointwise_numerical: baseline projected spatial library; np.gradient of projected u with edge_order=2; remove two frames at each end
sparse_protocol.pointwise_exact: supplied exact feature and u_t arrays; remove same two frames at each end
sparse_protocol.integrated: unchanged baseline Fourier features and Simpson window construction
sparse_protocol.development_selection: sqrt(mean(trajectory_MSE)); within 1.05*best+1e-12 choose fewest terms, error, stable ID
sparse_protocol.forecast: unchanged baseline forecast; each development trajectory initialized only from its own first frame

observed_preprocessing.noise_estimator: pooled observed upper-band Rayleigh scale, per trajectory
observed_preprocessing.mode_amplitude: sqrt(mean over observed frames of abs(spectrum)**2)
observed_preprocessing.threshold: max(estimated coefficient-noise RMS, numerical floor) * sqrt(2*log(Nx))
observed_preprocessing.mask: one time-shared mask per provided trajectory, DC always retained
observed_preprocessing.noise_model: constant-variance white Gaussian measurement noise with mostly noise in upper spatial band
observed_preprocessing.limitation: may remove weak physical modes or mistake broadband signal for noise

engine.alias_expansion: closure of one-for-one correlated-column replacements from successful L1 supports
engine.alias_support_limit: all nonempty subsets of the fixed nine-column library; no arbitrary first-k truncation
engine.alias_refit: equal-trajectory normalized OLS with the same numerical zero and rank rules as the L1 engine
engine.candidate_selection_score: sqrt(mean development-trajectory weak residual MSE) / own pooled training target RMS
engine.selected_order: minimum support size, development weak score, canonical candidate ID
engine.committee: all full-data near-pool vectors plus bootstrap near-pool vectors passing the full-data development threshold
engine.committee_alias_weighting: exact coefficient-vector duplicates merged; no lambda-path count is a vote
engine.bootstrap: sample entire training trajectories with replacement; keep development observations fixed
engine.development_reuse: development observations are reused for selection across rounds; not final validation
engine.bootstrap_caching: exact multiplicity vectors share one complete refit; deterministic per-trajectory weak transforms may be reused
engine.inclusion_frequency: fraction of requested bootstrap draws selecting the term; null if any draw failed
engine.frequency_interpretation: algorithmic resampling frequency, not posterior probability or calibrated confidence
engine.forward_guard: highest nonzero even derivative must be dissipative; no truth-specific coefficient bounds

forecast.name: equivalent_linear_prefix_acceleration

baseline.name: prefix_aligned_resolved_factor4
baseline.history: observed frames at or before forecast start only; endpoint shared once
baseline.estimator: independently filter each prefix frame, propagate each to cutoff with candidate PDE, equal mean of terminal states
baseline.weights: fixed equal per observed prefix frame, no development or final fitting

filter.input: one observed initial frame and its uniform periodic spatial grid only
filter.scale_band: integer modes floor(N/4) <= k < floor(N/2); DC and real Nyquist excluded
filter.rule: retain coefficients with magnitude >= threshold, always preserve DC; hard threshold only
filter.retained_modes: data dependent, no fixed physical modes and no family-specific rule
filter.phase: retained complex coefficients unchanged; irfft handles real Nyquist
filter.scale_assumption: additive spatial white Gaussian noise; upper-band majority is noise rather than signal
filter.limitations: single-frame sparse-spectrum prior; broadband signal can bias scale upward and weak physical modes can be removed

solver.factor_selection: fixed before new training/development generation; not family dependent
solver.initial_interpolation: real periodic Fourier interpolation of the observed initial frame; scipy.signal.resample handles even-grid Nyquist splitting
solver.internal_grid: Nx*factor equally spaced points on the same period, starting at the observed x[0]
solver.solver: unchanged pde_discovery.generic_engine.forecast on the internal grid
solver.output: direct restriction to every factor-th internal point at the original output times
solver.scope: uniform periodic scalar autonomous constant-coefficient nine-term PDE

baseline.forecast_horizon: unchanged after cutoff; prefix not counted as predicted future
baseline.limitations: candidate-model bias and sparse-spectrum initial-filter prior; not independent propagated estimates

forecast.change: mathematically equivalent computation optimization, not new physics or model selection
forecast.eligibility: accumulated coefficients of u^2, u^3 and u*u_x are exactly zero
forecast.linear_solver: exact Fourier exponential and stable constant-DC forcing integral
forecast.interpolation_projection: unchanged scipy.signal.resample then original internal-grid Fourier projection
forecast.prefix: same per-frame filter, propagation to cutoff, and equal mean of restricted terminal states
forecast.nonlinear_solver: unchanged prefix_study.forecast and resolved factor-4 ETDRK4
forecast.guards: same coordinates, term accumulation, dissipativity, integration budget, linear-step and finite-state growth limits
forecast.linear_stage_guard: each non-DC modal magnitude and absolute real DC state attain their maximum at a time endpoint
forecast.agreement: mathematical equivalence; ordinary floating-point differences from repeated ETDRK4 products remain

acquisition.legacy_policies: delegate original select_action unchanged, including all diagnostics and failure handling
acquisition.rich_then_variance: empty used_action_ids: original fixed_rich; otherwise original ensemble_variance
acquisition.rich_then_information: empty used_action_ids: original fixed_rich; otherwise conditional relative-coefficient inverse-Gram trace reduction
acquisition.first_action: both new policies use precisely the original fixed_rich result on the same action pool
acquisition.information_anchor: one full-data selected candidate supplied by the caller; never a bootstrap mean or reference equation
acquisition.support_interpretation: conditional on the selected support; neither singleton nor well-conditioned Gram proves the support correct
acquisition.observed_transform: unchanged active_study.engine.preprocess_observation then weak_study.engine.weak_block(resolved), all supplied training frames
acquisition.trajectory_weight: each acquired independent trajectory contributes X.T@X divided by its own weak row count; contributions accumulate
acquisition.column_scale: s_j = sqrt(mean_trajectory mean_rows X_ij^2), computed once from currently acquired observations
acquisition.target_scale: q = sqrt(mean_trajectory mean_rows y_i^2), computed once from currently acquired observations
acquisition.relative_coefficient_scale: theta_j = abs(selected_coefficient_j) * s_j / q; no coefficient clipping or term deletion
acquisition.prospective_gram: G_a = Z_a.T@Z_a / row_count_a; same observed s, q and anchor coefficients for every action
acquisition.ridge: lambda = ridge_relative * max(trace(G)/support_size, 1), shared unchanged by all actions in the round
acquisition.trace_reduction_computation: PSD square-root identity using C=A^-1/2 G_a A^-1/2; sum(mu/(1+mu)*column_norm(A^-1/2 eigenvectors(C))^2)
acquisition.predictor: unchanged original.candidate_forecast; [0,.1] burn-in then uniform linspace(.1,1.1,33), because the original solver requires uniform time grids
acquisition.weak_prediction_input: only the 33 post-prefix candidate-predicted frames; no prospective measured field
acquisition.predicted_preprocessing: same unchanged observed spectral filtering on the candidate-predicted field; an approximation, no artificial measurement noise is added
acquisition.predicted_temporal_resolution: 33 frames are a declared design approximation; actual discovery and final validation retain their original 101 frames and full duration
acquisition.score_tie: within score_tie_atol + score_tie_rtol*abs(max_score), original fixed_rich richness/entropy/id ordering
acquisition.observed_support_rank: same 1e-10 singular-value rank rule as the existing normalized support solver; deficient support falls back explicitly
acquisition.failure: retain invalid anchor, observed geometry and per-action prediction failures; choose original fixed_rich if geometry fails or all actions are invalid/uninformative

controller.measurement_cost: future field plus history except shared endpoint; all training and development charged
controller.query_failure_cost: a legal started query consumes one attempt and its full reserved measurement budget
controller.invalid_action: reject before provider invocation; no free retries or replacement queries
controller.candidate_rollouts: model computation only, never observed experiments
controller.benchmark_stopping: run every budget checkpoint, no truth-based or final-based stopping
controller.one_candidate: candidate only, never proof of uniqueness; permit coverage exploration
controller.initial_fit_cache: same common initial observations and ensemble seed shared by all six policies
controller.bootstrap_seed: same seed+round counter for every policy within the paired task

formal_role_note: oldformal0..11 were viewed; newformal120..137 and newinitial/finalaction seeds are reserved until freeze
interpretation: Local conditional A-optimal proxy; not calibrated information or covariance; only acquisition changed.
